title: Workflows
description: Chain agents, tools and decisions. Test the draft, publish a version, and follow every run step by step, live.
readOnly: You can view workflows and their runs. Building them needs the member role or above.
loadError: The workflows could not be loaded.

list.title: Workflows
list.emptyBody: A workflow runs several steps in order — agents, tools, conditions and transforms — and returns one result. Start from a template and adjust it.

create.title: New workflow
create.description: Name it and pick a starting point — every step can be changed afterwards.
create.name: Name
create.nameTaken: Another workflow already has this name.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What it does, for your teammates

blank.title: Blank
blank.body: Input → output. Add the steps yourself.

branch.title: Decision
branch.body: An agent answers, then a condition sends urgent answers to an escalation step.

create.needsAgent: Needs an agent: create one first.

typeHelp.start: Where each run begins: the text or JSON you send.
typeHelp.agent: Runs one of your agents on an input built from earlier results.
typeHelp.tool: Calls a tool with arguments built from earlier results.
typeHelp.condition: Sends the run down the “yes” or the “no” branch.
typeHelp.transform: Builds text or JSON from earlier results.
typeHelp.end: Returns the result of the run.

editor.conflictBody: Your latest changes were not saved. Reload to see the current draft, then apply them again.
editor.publishHint: Publish the draft as the version that runs.
editor.publishBody: Runs use the published version; the draft stays editable.
editor.archivedBanner: This workflow is archived. Restore it to edit or run it.
editor.readOnlyBanner: Read-only: your role cannot edit workflows.
editor.selectHint: Select a step to edit it. To link two steps, drag from the dot under a step to another step — or use “Next steps” in a step's panel.
editor.shortcuts: Delete removes the selection · Ctrl+Z undoes · Ctrl+S saves now.
editor.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another workspace.

inspector.title: Properties
inspector.timeoutHelp: A run that takes longer is stopped (10 s to 1 h).
inspector.timeoutError: Enter a number of seconds between 10 and 3600.
inspector.label: Name
inspector.versionHelp: Pin a version, or follow the agent's current one.
inspector.inputHelp: What the agent receives. Insert the run input or earlier results.
inspector.argumentsHelp: Values may use templates such as {{example}}.
inspector.jsonInvalid: This is not valid JSON yet.
inspector.branchesHelp: Link the “yes” and “no” handles to the steps that follow each answer. The tested value is passed on.
inspector.endOutputHelp: Leave empty to return the result of the step before.
inspector.validateInput: Check the input against a schema
inspector.inputSchemaHelp: Runs whose input does not match are refused before they start.
inspector.startLocked: Every workflow starts at its input step: it cannot be removed.

runDialog.title: Run “{{name}}”
runDialog.descriptionDraft: Runs the draft as it is now, without publishing it.
runDialog.placeholder: What should this run work on?
runDialog.schemaHint: Pre-filled from the workflow's expected input.

run.title: Run
run.selectStep: Select a step, here or on the graph, to see what went in and out.
run.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another workspace.

versions.empty: No version published yet. Publish the draft to make it the one that runs.
versions.restoreBody: The draft is replaced by this version (publish it to make it current again). The published version does not change.

menu.deleteBody: The workflow and its versions are deleted for good.
menu.hasHistory: This workflow has runs in its history: archive it instead to keep them.

a11y.node: Press Enter to select this step, or the arrow keys to move it.
a11y.nodeReadOnly: Press Enter to select this step.
